GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize 'Enterprise Premium' aesthetic: confident, measured, corporate, architectural.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than standard) for a luxurious, uncrowded feel.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Avoid centered layouts for dense information; use structural, grid-based asymmetry.
Never use generic AI emojis or cliché 'glowing brain' metaphors.
Ensure hover states are clear and accessible, with micro-interactions.

typography.font_family: 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

headings.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-medium tracking-tighter text-[#F5F5F5]
headings.h3: text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#F5F5F5]

typography.accent_labels: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#F5F5F5]
typography.notes: Typography is critical here. Headings must have tight letter spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em) and use SF Pro. No generic Inter for headings.

colors.notes: Strictly dark cinematic environment. No neon greens or purples. Use grayscale, whites, and subtle silver for depth.

layouts.hero: 100vh full-screen section with massive masked text. Z-index layering with a fixed/sticky 3D canvas behind the HTML content.
layouts.domain_sections: Use high-density grids or expansive asymmetrical layouts (e.g., 12-col grid where text spans 4 cols and the 3D element dominates the rest).
layouts.capability_matrix: Spatial floating panels using CSS 3D transforms or Framer Motion to create a depth-based matrix.
layouts.spacing: Massive gaps between major sections (`py-32` or `py-48`) to let the 3D scrolling animations breathe.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_physics: Lenis for smooth scrolling, connected to the GSAP ticker.
motion_and_interactions.storytelling_engine: GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate pinning and sequence reveals.
motion_and_interactions.ui_interactions: Framer Motion for magnetic buttons, custom cursor, and subtle UI entering animations.
motion_and_interactions.custom_cursor: A small `#F5F5F5` dot that tracks the mouse and expands when hovering over clickable elements.
motion_and_interactions.text_reveals: Mask text reveals for key statements: wrapping text lines in `overflow-hidden` containers and animating `translateY` from 100% to 0%.

3d_libraries_and_strategy.Intelligence_Core: Render a central R3F Canvas. Use `MeshPhysicalMaterial` for a glass/computational sphere with orbiting rings and floating data particles (`Points`). MUST NOT look like a human brain.
3d_libraries_and_strategy.Scroll_Reactivity: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to mutate the camera position, object scale, and rotation of the 3D core as the user scrolls down through the chapters.
3d_libraries_and_strategy.Wireframe_Globe: Custom R3F sphere with lines or dots to represent the USA/India/Australia global footprint.

component_instructions.App.jsx: Main orchestrator. Wraps everything in Lenis, sets up the R3F Canvas as a fixed background, and overlays HTML sections. Note: use `.jsx` or `.js` extension.
component_instructions.MagneticButton.jsx: Use Framer Motion to track mouse position within the button bounds and slightly translate the text/icon towards the cursor.
component_instructions.KineticTypography.jsx: Horizontal scrolling sequence for 'Data -> Understand -> Predict -> Optimize -> Decide -> Act'.

image_urls.description: Cinematic dark background texture. Use with very low opacity (5-10%) as an overlay to break up pure #050505 digital flatness.
Modern architectural facade. Can be used in the AI x Infrastructure domain chapter to represent structural wireframes.
Human and robotic hands reaching out. Perfect subtle background for the AI x People (Human+Machine) Augmented Intelligence moment.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #F5F5F5 text is readable against the 3D models. Use radial gradients or text shadows behind text if the 3D scene gets too bright.
accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for GSAP and Framer Motion.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic AI slop. Do not use glowing brains, neon colors, or cyberpunk clichés. The vibe is 'Enterprise Premium'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Never apply `transition: all` globally in CSS. It breaks transforms.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use layered z-index: Base background -> 3D Canvas -> HTML UI overlay.
Implement a single continuous scrolling journey where the 3D scene transitions seamlessly behind the HTML UI.
Make sure the 3D Core is properly lit using ambient and directional lights within R3F.
Ensure 'INTELLIGENCE AT THE CORE' text masking works flawlessly in the hero section.
The 'Intelligence Loop' (Sense/Understand/Predict/Optimize/Act/Learn) must be visually cyclical and interactive.
Ensure that testing attributes `data-testid` are placed on major interactive elements.
Do NOT add a fully transparent background to overlay components without a backdrop-blur.
